maria: quick FYI — the runbook at <https://kb.redwood/runtime/kv-cache#cache-keys> is jumping to the wrong anchor in preview (404). also our markdown linter flagged a stray colon in the frontmatter (line 3). Can whoever owns runtime/kv-cache.md take a tiny patch? @anya @sam

anya: I can pick this up in ~30m. Is this blocking any deploys or just failing the nightly docs smoke?

mike: not blocking deploys, just failing the nightly docs build and failing the anchor smoke test. quick sed to clean the stray colon worked locally for me:```
# run from repo root
sed -i 's/^title: \"\(.*\)\":/title: \"\1\"/' docs/runtime/kv-cache.md
```

anya: thanks — I'll open a tiny PR that fixes the anchor (TOC id mismatch) + frontmatter change. also noticed this file has no CODEOWNERS entry; can someone add ownership (eng-platform/docs) or tag who should own it?

docs-bot: PR created by anya: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2583> — "docs: fix kv-cache anchor + frontmatter". CI: docs-build ✔️, linkcheck running.

sam: LGTM from my side. can we add a small smoke test to prevent regressions? e.g. assert the TOC anchor resolves in the static preview step.

anya: good call — I'll add a minimal check to docs/ci/link-checks.js and update PR. tagging eng-sre for CI flakiness if linkcheck flakes. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome, thanks all — marking this as done in the sprint board once PR merges.
